presentation.label: REWIRE
presentation.summary: Five lo-fi blocks (crush, drive, ring mod, comb, frequency shift) in a chain you can reorder.
presentation.overview: Five lo-fi blocks (crush, drive, ring mod, comb, frequency shift) in a chain you can reorder.

controls.name: Route
controls.doc: Block order, five permutations: BDRCS, SCRDB, DSBCR, RCSBD, SBRDC (B=Bits D=Drive R=Ring C=Comb S=Shift). On knob 1 deliberately -- it is the control this effect exists for, and knobs 1-2 use the verbatim-stock edit handlers. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Bits
controls.doc: Word length and sample-rate decimation together, 12-bit down to 3-bit with the hold rising alongside. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Drive
controls.doc: Asymmetric soft clip, gain-compensated so turning it up does not just get louder. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Ring
controls.doc: Ring modulator carrier, 30 Hz to ~2.2 kHz. Depth fades in from silence at 0 so the block is genuinely absent when down -- but it no longer DEFAULTS to absent, because with both Ring and Shift inert only three blocks were in the chain and Route had almost nothing left to permute. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Comb
controls.doc: Short feedback comb, depth and length together. The only feedback path here, clamped below unity so no routing can make it run away. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tone
controls.doc: Low-pass on the wet path. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
